status: frozen for source review; not built or run

flag.name: TURBO_QWEN_DECODE_METADATA_FOUR
flag.scope: Trusted-receipt validation inside one normal produce call with an explicit operation-owned latch. No app integration.

eligibility: The factory completes full serial validation before issuing a private handle/receipt-bound validator.
Both modes acquire that same kind of serial proof before prompt timing. No arbitrary receipt or unvalidated handle can construct it.
The runner rejects a supplied diagnostic validator unless hooks.isKnownNone is the private static-none witness. Any supplied closure, even empty, is ineligible.
One latch is created per produce, retained by the cancellation handler and forwarded through timing wrappers, token execution and MoE.
Prefill, turn, sampler, no-receipt and no-validator/latch paths remain serial. The original validator signature stays serial.
scanChecks: Retain validateBinding, receipt identity/inventory checks, requireRoot, full listing and expected subset check.
Four fixed contiguous index ranges process ascending entries. Each entry preserves original open flags, held fstat, named fstatat, type/link/fingerprint/identity, remember and close sequence.
Each lane checks the latch before its fresh open and stops at its first indexed error. Already opened work completes and closes.
All lanes join before selecting the lowest receipt-index observed error. No source error or EMFILE/ENFILE is retried or replaced by success.
Only after a successful joined scan run original root-after and binding boundaries, then the complete second scan and final binding.

Post-map validation stays synchronous. No await or scheduling change is inserted between that check and MoE submission. Payload reader checkpoints, LFU demand plans, routes, weights and arithmetic remain unchanged.
cancellation: onCancel changes only the monotonic mutex-protected Bool. It holds no actor state, FD or task handle.
Existing caller geometry/reentrancy/initial/final Task checks and rollback remain.
Cancellation observed before an entry is indexed at that entry. No later entry in that lane opens. Other lanes settle.
A file already opened finishes its checks and deferred close. No lock covers I/O or joining.
Late cancellation remains subject to original caller/binding checks. It does not override an already indexed error.

counters.requiredAcrossArms: Full-source count and entry checks equal, zero failures.
counters.sourceWall: Caller wall around actual revalidateSource, including immutable full-receipt equality, counters, all root/list/binding checks, dispatch and join.
counters.addedOverhead: Full receipt equality and owned entry counters add cost in BOTH arms. Report is not worker-scheduling cost alone.
counters.entryFDPeak: Counter increments after each successful entry open and decrements after close. Only entry FDs are counted; retained and root/list helper FDs are separate. Owned entry limit is1 serial and4 parallel.
counters.processCPU: getrusage cumulative user/system up to report preparation, plus difference across whole decode. CPU is separate evidence and is not additive interval attribution.
counters.timing: Prompt and whole29-output decode separately. Per-forward timing is secondary only. Same passive route/plan recording in both arms.

gate.firstPairStop: Any correctness/check/memory failure, ON/OFF whole decode ratio>0.97, or parallel validation mean>1050000ns stops before reverse.
gate.bothOrdersRequired: Whole decode ON/OFF ratio<=0.97 AND parallel full-source mean<=1050000ns in BOTH order pairs.
gate.exactness: All29 sampled IDs,1120 actual route IDs/weight bit rows,1120 actual LFU demand plans match.
gate.limits: Isolated eligibility only. A representative app trial is still required.

memory.buffers: No new model, expert buffers, FP32 router cache or prefetch allocation.

knownDifferences: Up to three extra concurrent entry descriptors can produce EMFILE/ENFILE where serial could succeed. Original unavailable-file failure is preserved. No free-FD check promises reserved capacity.
Different inter-entry visitation changes the timing of transient observations and may select a different observed error. Same complete fresh checks do not imply temporal equivalence.
Caller shouldStop remains its existing token-boundary behavior. Dispatch workers receive only the owned cancellation latch.
The fixed successful request does not exercise cancellation or rollback. It reports terminal runner state and joined entry ownership, not adversarial safety qualification.
